# Build output directory

Generated by `../scripts/build-image.sh`:

- `pi-invest-os-<version>-arm64.img` — raw flashable image
- `pi-invest-os-<version>-arm64.img.xz` — compressed (preferred to share)
- `pi-invest-os-<version>-arm64.sha256` — checksums

These files are gitignored (multi‑GB). Rebuild locally or download a release artifact.
